children.game_version: A follow-the-leader game in a half-circle, focusing on the transition from slow to fast movements.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm movements and torso rotations while seated in a semi-circle.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the balancing and turning movements with support from a chair or partner, omitting jumps and kneeling.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Initially holding shoulders, transitioning to holding hands.
movement_profile.partnering: Group connection via shoulder or hand holds.

signature_moves.description: Controlled movement performed in the initial phase.
signature_moves.name: Balancing

signature_moves.description: Athletic movement performed during the faster phase.
signature_moves.name: Jumping

signature_moves.description: Lowering to the ground during the faster phase.
signature_moves.name: Kneeling

signature_moves.description: Rotation performed during the faster phase.
signature_moves.name: Turning

music_profile.sound_description: The music follows a 2/4 rhythm and supports a transition from medium-fast balancing to faster, high-energy movements.

basic_steps: Balancing in a half-circle formation while holding shoulders.
Transitioning to holding hands as the tempo increases.
Executing jumps, kneeling, and turning movements.
teaching.level_notes: Intermediate, due to the requirement of jumping and kneeling.
